_doc: Files fetched for the close-out of timeline shard tl-01. archive.org only, one request at a time, no login. Raw files live under tmp/tl-01/dl (untracked). Fourth start (2026-11-15): the items "ca-*" are crops of page images of 1863 newspapers (IIIF regions of the Library of Congress image service, one request each, at most one per second); the crops are regenerated from the url; the files under tmp/tl-01/crops are untracked scratch. Fourth start, later the same day: the items cu31924028852619 and greatinvasionof102hoke are the whole-book PDFs of the two books added to the builder (extra_sources.py); only the pages listed under pages_viewed were rendered and looked at; the PDFs are untracked scratch under tmp/tl-01/dl/books2. The item hs-mcpherson-farm.pdf (the National Park Service study of the McPherson farm, npshistory.com) was fetched once in the same way, to view the cited pages.
